title: Multiple Choice – Word Families
description: Choose the correct word to complete each sentence.

questions.text: The chemical spill caused severe river __________ that threatened local drinking water supplies.
Aluminum cans and glass containers are completely __________ materials that we should never throw away.
Many organic farmers strive to manage their acreage __________ to protect soil quality.
Greasy napkins can __________ an entire batch of clean cardboard during processing.
Leaving electrical appliances running in empty classrooms is a very __________ habit.
Warm summer temperatures accelerate the __________ of organic kitchen scraps in the compost barrel.
Shoppers who bring their own __________ cloth bags help prevent millions of plastic sacks from polluting oceans.
The delivery service wraps fragile glass bottles in protective paper __________.
Educating young citizens on environmental __________ ensures the long-term protection of natural habitats.
Smoke particles from coal-fired power stations act as a dangerous atmospheric __________.
